name: AK23B - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), Big-Digit Display
highlights: One Reading, Very Large — PM2.5 dominates the centre of the screen at several times the size of anything else, with the remaining values as labelled groups around it. Readable from a distance no dial layout matches.
Grouped Labels Instead of Dials — HCHO and TVOC as one pair, the three PM fractions as another, CO₂ on its own — the screen is organised by what the reading means, not by sensor.
Same Sensing as AK23A — Eight parameters, laser particulate split, AQI scale. The choice between them is purely which face suits the room.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour USB-C charge, 240 g.
Shares Everything but the Screen — Same enclosure, packaging and 32-per-carton spec as AK23A — two distinct products for your catalogue at the cost of one tooling.

specs.Readings: CO2, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, HCHO, TVOC, temperature, humidity, AQI
